author: The Film Theorists
description:
*Watch the film here!* ► http://www.amazon.com/subscription/lionsgate+ 

Kick-Ass may not have super strength, super speed, or laser eyes, but he DOES have one advantage: he can’t feel pain! Sounds like the perfect power for fighting crime, right? Well, Theorists, science says this “superpower” might actually get him killed.
